headline: Andy Burnham urges caution on potential moves to scrap Premier League 3pm blackout
description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he would "urge caution" on scrapping the Saturday 3pm blackout.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Will Bruno Fernandes stay put at Man United?
description: Bruno Fernandes' future at Manchester United is reportedly uncertain with his contract expiring next summer. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Haaland 'incredibly happy' at Man City, not thinking about possible sanctions
description: Erling Haaland says he is "incredibly happy" at Manchester City and his focus is on performing and not on the potential sanctions against the club.

headline: Arsenal's Bruno Guimarães: Learning a lot from 'machine' Declan Rice
description: Bruno Guimarães has labelled Arsenal teammate Declan Rice a "machine" and said he's been learning a lot by playing alongside him.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino to Man United: Is Tottenham love affair finally over?
description: Mauricio Pochettino is back in the Premier League as the new Man United boss. For Tottenham fans, it's complicated.

headline: Every Manchester United player, manager, executive since Glazers' takeover: Where are they now?
description: The Glazer family took over Manchester United in 2005, but what has happened to the players, managers and executive staff since?
